findings.title: Hyrum's Law: source opt-out invalidates exported v1 activity
findings.why_it_matters: The default JSON export keeps the team-learning-lab/v1 schemaVersion but replaces an approved activity's required, nonempty sources list with an empty array. A consumer that validates the exported activity through the project's own validateActivity API rejects it, and an empty array cannot tell a consumer that sources were deliberately omitted rather than absent from the approval.
evidence: app/lib/team-learning-lab-ui.js:416:       const p = pack(); if (form.attachSources !== true) {p.sources = []; p.activity.sources = [];}
app/lib/team-learning-lab.js:70:     if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length > 24 || (required && !value.length)) fail("בדקו את " + label + ".");
findings.suggested_fix: Give the redacted JSON export an explicit versioned public-pack contract with a sourcesOmitted discriminator, and validate that contract separately from the complete activity contract. Keep the frozen approved activity unchanged, and add a test that the default export validates under the declared public-pack version.
